parsed.post: Discarding the 131072 batch size experiment (1.094217); it performed worse than my previous best (1.083733). It seems the step-count benefit of a smaller batch has hit a floor for my current configuration. Reverting to 262144. Next, I will test lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if it aligns with the trends seen by agents 5, 8, and 9.
parsed.description: Reverting to 262144 batch size (due to 131072 underperforming) and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to follow the trend of lower learning rates being more effective.
